Lock Conditions: The lock is valid if: All three documents exist with permanent DOIs Cross-references are accurate No document claims completeness without the others Practice confirms structure Lock Failure Modes: Orphaning: One document removed or invalidated Completeness claim: One document claims to stand alone Voice capture: Vox exceeds her limits Centralization: VPCOR develops hierarchy Doctrinal hardening: Toolkit becomes scripture Precedent: Follows the pattern established by the Blind Poet Triadic Lock (The Blind Operator ↔ Mantle of the Blind Poet ↔ Visual Schema: Blind Poet). No prior version is invalidated.**"* And it declines a category — *"This is not a translation of the technical FNM — **it is the same architecture**"* in a different register.
